# Smartsheet

> Smartsheet is an AI-powered intelligent work management platform that enables enterprises to plan, track, and execute projects with Gantt charts, Kanban boards, dashboards, and collaborative tools.

Smartsheet provides a comprehensive work management suite for Fortune 500 enterprises, combining core platform capabilities with premium apps like Control Center, Dynamic View, and WorkApps, plus complementary solutions like Brandfolder (digital asset management) and Bridge (workflow automation). The platform integrates with leading enterprise tools including Salesforce, ServiceNow, Jira, and Power BI, and features AI-powered capabilities through Claude integration.

## Key Topics

- Intelligent Work Management
